C0440.title: Analysis of Emerging Credential Stuffing Attacks Involving AI Agents
C0440.summary: A HUMAN Security research article observed early evidence of suspected AI-agent-assisted carding behavior in real web traffic as AI-agent traffic surged. The traffic showed characteristics of automated payment-card validation and testing, suggesting that carding attacks may be evolving through agentic AI traffic rather than relying only on traditional scripts.

references.title: AI Agents and Fraud: Early Evidence of Carding Behavior in the Wild
